run_adsorption_relaxation: run AdsorptionRunner to relax adsorbate plus surface configurations and compute adsorption energy
calculate_adsorption_energy: calculate adsorption energy by relaxing atoms with a specified ASE calculator and LBFGS optimizer
write_adsorption_results: write adsorption calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
configure_adsorption_runner: configure AdsorptionRunner with custom fmax convergence threshold and maximum relaxation steps
relax_surface_with_adsorbate: relax both the adsorbate and bare surface using AdsorptionRunner with relax_surface enabled
